== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Come With Me (Errata)]] (<code>2_118d</code>, A New Hope, Dark Side), showing the Decipher errata game text. This reconstructed full-card face is distinct from the actual published [[:File:ANH-D-Come-With-Me-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p38-entry.png|1998 document entry]] and [[:File:ANH-D-Come-With-Me-Decipher-Supplement-2002-p2-entry.png|2002 document entry]]: the printed card ([[:File:ANH-D-comewithme-decipher-archive.gif]]) shows the original printed text of [[Come With Me]], and the Players Committee Holotable face ([[:File:ANH-D-comewithme.gif]], D-E1) shows the later PC errata text of [[Come With Me (PC Errata 3)]].

* '''Text source:''' Decipher [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), repeated word for word in the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] (updated 29 January 2002).
* '''Errata text:''' “Use 1 Force to target a starfighter’s permanent pilot. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, deploy on starfighter to remove permanent pilot (otherwise, Effect is lost). May add 1 pilot. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 12 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker): the A New Hope card <code>2_118</code> (Decipher art from the art library, frame, title, lore, destiny 4, copyright line as printed; Decipher-style expansion sphere) with the errata game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Game text is re-typeset, so line breaks differ from any printed card; words are the Glossary's.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.
